name: candyco-labor-detail
description: Amy's daily Labor Detail with Claude: say 'build the labor detail for yesterday'. Claude reads the three plants' shift workbooks and daily schedules from the synced S Drive and NetSuite work-order completions, rebuilds the Daily Report numbers, walks you through the items that need your judgment (off-schedule runs, count gaps, planned time, lunch rotations), then builds the Labor Detail workbook in your layout and your summary email, and publishes both after you approve.
